name: Learn hacky sack
blurb: Footbag: keeping a small beanbag in the air with your feet. Three basic kicks, and it is one of the best coordination workouts you can do in a car park.
gear: A footbag — sand or pellet filled, not a hard ball
steps: Learn the inside kick: strike with the flat inside of the foot, ankle locked, knee lifted so the surface is horizontal.
Learn the outside kick, which is harder and needs the ankle rolled.
Learn the toe kick, using the flat top of the shoe.
Practise a controlled drop-and-kick with each foot, aiming to send the bag straight up to chest height.
Chain kicks together, alternating feet, and count your streak.
Learn a stall — catching and holding the bag on the foot — as the gateway to tricks.
tips: Kick it upwards, not forwards. Chasing the bag around a car park is the beginner experience.
Keep the contact surface flat and the ankle locked. A loose ankle sends it anywhere.
proof: Twenty consecutive kicks, alternating feet, without the bag touching the ground.
